indicators.context: Header every CyberStrikeAI implant and curl one-liner request carries, with a fixed value per C2 listener (beacon.go.tmpl:375, payload_oneliner.go:184). Kaspersky used it to identify the implant NeuroSploit's C2 beacons send the same header (JoasASantos/NeuroSploit).
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CyberStrikeAI source code
